name: La Pared
medium: rendered HTML + Canvas2D, screenshot at 1440x900 — no image model available this session
focal: the single brass plaque inside the candle pool
fixed_across_comps: Gauchito red as the committed carrier
candle-warm key; the visitor carries the light
celeste withheld from the entire palette until a release is earned
Chivo for engraved plaque capitals, Alegreya for votive text
must_not_literalize: plaque copy and dates are real and load-bearing, but their placement is compositional, not a layout spec
the offering and plaque counts are illustrative of proportion, not final content
image slots are deliberately empty or marked SIN IMAGEN — the image ladder is undecided by the user's choice
risk: Lateral movement is the closest of the three to a scroll.
prompt: El Santuario, first viewport, desktop 1440x900. A vast wall of votive plaques running past both edges of frame, hundreds deep, warm-black ground. The visitor carries a single candle: a warm radial pool at 30%/58% brightens five or six plaques and falls off hard into black. Tin plaques read TE PIDO with stadium and date; one brass plaque reads GRACIAS POR EL FAVOR CONCEDIDO, Maracana 10-VII-2021. Tapered Gauchito-red ribbons hang from above frame across the wall. Chivo engraved capitals. No navigation chrome. Celeste absent.
